Package index

Core Functions

get_seed()
Get a new fresh seed from the latest pulse sent by a Beacon of choice.
reset_seed_log()
Remove stale seed logs to allow acquiring and logging a new random value

Public Utilities

Utilities that may be useful for everyday use of the package, not only for developers

read_logs()
Read the debug log
verify_log()
Verify the contents of a seed log are internally consistent

Beacons

Currently available Beacon implementations

Internal

Internal functions for developers

.onLoad()
Hook to run when loading the package.
.reset_data_dir()
Delete the data directory where seed log and debug log files are stored by default
.any_is_null()
Check if there are any nulls in a list of objects
.as_bits()
Helper for visualizing the raw bit form of a byte vector
.change_byte()
Change the leading byte of a hash digest by one bit
.cli_progress_output()
Write a temporary msg to stdout that will be removed upon progressbar completion
.concatenate_hashes()
Convert and concatenate two values into a single raw bytes objec
.delete_json()
Delete a file if it is a JSON file type
.delete_json_in_dir()
Delete every JSON file in a directory
.dt_to_ms()
Convert from a lubridate-style datetime to a NIST 'milliseconds since epoch' representation
.get_beacon_defaults()
Get the options that need to be set for a specific Beacon to work
.get_beacon_json()
Read the JSON file specifying default settings values for a specific Beacon
.get_option()
Get the value of a beacr-specific global option
.hex_str_to_raw()
Convert from a hexadecimal character string to a sequence of raw hex bytes
.is_integer_like()
Check if a value can be represented as an integer without loss
.ms_to_dt()
Convert from NIST 'milliseconds-since-epoch' to a workable datetime via lubridate
.posix_to_NIST_UNIX()
Convert from R's POSIXct data type to the time encoding used by the NISTBeacon, namely milliseconds since epoch
.preregistration_exists()
Verify if any preregistration information was provided Currently used in get_seed and verify_log
.printt()
Print out NIST UNIX timestamps (milliseconds since epoch) in a readable way
.prompt_menu()
Thin wrapper around menu to allow mocking in tests as mocking menu is unsupported`
.sanitize_url()
Sanitize preregistration identifier strings and parse for OSF file IDs
.seed_log_exists()
Check for seed log in directory
.setup_logging()
Set up logger for the package
.set_option()
Set the value of a beacr-specific global option
.timeStamp_to_unix_time()
Converts a string return value from an API that represents a timestamp into a timestamp integer in the format expected by the NISTBeacon; namely, milliseconds since epoch
.to_raw()
Dispatcher for conversion to atomic raw byte vector type
